    AI Overview
    Bobby Hurley
     is the older brother of UConn men’s basketball coach Dan Hurley. A legendary Duke All-American point guard and former NBA player, Bobby is currently a head coach (formerly at Arizona State). They are the sons of Hall of Fame New Jersey high school coach Bob Hurley Sr.. 
    Key Details About Bobby Hurley: 
    • Playing Career: Bobby was a standout player at Duke University, winning two NCAA championships (
      ). He is the NCAA all-time assist leader and was the 7th pick in the 1993 NBA Draft.
    • Coaching Career: Following his playing career, he became a college coach, notably leading the Arizona State Sun Devils.
    • Family Background:
      Both Danny and Bobby were coached by their father, Bob Hurley Sr., at St. Anthony High School in Jersey City.
    • Brotherly Bond: Despite competing as coaches, the brothers are very close, with Dan often citing Bobby as a mentor, notes NCAA.com.

    Are Bobby and Dan Hurley related?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Yes, Dan Hurley is the younger brother of Bobby Hurley. They are prominent basketball coaches and the sons of Hall of Fame high school coach Bob Hurley Sr.. While Bobby was a star player at Duke, Dan has achieved major success as the head coach at UConn. 
    • Relationship: They are brothers, born 19 months apart.
    • Family Background: Their father, Bob Hurley Sr., is a legendary Hall of Fame coach from St. Anthony High School in Jersey City.
    • Coaching Connection: Bobby previously worked as an assistant coach for Dan at Wagner and Rhode Island.
    • Current Roles:
      Dan Hurley is the head coach at UConn, while Bobby Hurley is the head coach at Arizona State.
       
    Both brothers are deeply involved in basketball, continuing their father's legacy in the sport.
